entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Changing CompilerGeneratedFilesOutputPath / EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles leaves stale source-generated file paths, Hot Reload fails #86639
  • [Known Build Error] System.IO.IOException : Connection reset by peer #86637
  • Unnecessary definite assignment error in an inline array scenario #86631
    Backlog

Closed

  • Union creation expression requires a `CollectionBuilderAttribute` on it, but only if the collection value is specified inline and without the `new` keyword. #86621
    18.15

PullRequests

Created

  • Use `Get[Async]IterationType` APIs in `foreach` snippet provider #86638
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Mark Csi MSBuild task as multithread-safe #86636
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Suppress diagnostic fixes when multiple members are selected #86635
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Avoid offering type refactorings when only members are selected #86634
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Trim entries and ignore empty segments when splitting TargetFrameworks #86633
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Support relative paths in globalconfig section names #86632
    Area-Compilers
  • Inherit SynthesizedUnionCtor from SourceConstructorSymbolBase rather than from SynthesizedInstanceConstructor #86630
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Fix Razor directive and tag helper attribute regressions #86629
    Area-Razor

Merged

  • Add src/ProjectData to CODEOWNERS #86626
    Area-Infrastructure, Next

Updated

  • Avoid reusing interpolated string tokens after incremental edits #86578
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Support generating explicit ToString/PrintMembers for records #86611
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Pick a file name that isn't in use when moving static members to a new type #86597
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Keep trailing trivia in sync when reusing syntax nodes #86582
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Replace path-separator checks in PlatformInformation with RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform #86628
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3146581 #86598
    Area-Razor
  • Inline arrays: disallow capture with address-of #86325
    Area-Compilers
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #86370
    Area-Infrastructure
